newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Gas Oil/Jet- East-West spread widens on rally.
newsitem.headline: Asia Gas Oil/Jet- East-West spread widens on rally.

text.p: The gas oil spread between Asia and Europe has widened to around $35 per tonne as Singapore gas oil prices continued to rally, traders said on Friday.
Following a deal seen at $27.00 for an end-March/early April gas oil cargo on Friday, the east-west spread has opened the arbitrage window from North West Europe and the Mediterranean wide open.
With freight rates at around $24-$25 a tonne, traders said there was already talk that more cargoes might make their way to Asia.

Gas oil values have gained almost $2.00 over the past one week on active buying by a local trader. The trader has bought about 740,000 barrels of physical gas oil and about two million barrels of swaps over the past two days.
Two sellers appeared to offer early April cargoes at $27.15 and $27.40 a barrel, while a bid was seen for end-March at $26.80.

While gas oil gained in strength, jet fuel slipped marginally with 100,000 barrels done for March 22-26 at $29.00 a barrel, down 50 cents from the previous deal. The regrade also dipped to be bid at $1.50 from Thursday's quotes of $2.00/$2.40.
